item_data.name: Jazz Sunday in the Spacement
item_data.description:
Come down to the Liberty Hall speakeasy lounge, The Spacement, (entrance down the stairs on 7th street below The Plant Shop) and enjoy some fine local Jazz, curated to perfection with a rotating trio or quartet from your very own town!

Doors 6:30, Show from 7-9pm
Limited capacity so come early!
